teacher_imitation_note: Command R² 0.937/0.905 with held-out RMSE 0.178/0.171 V; approximate imitation, with occasional large command errors.
stability_scope: 75 internal five-second episodes: zero nonfinite/failing episodes, bounded commands and no observed excursions beyond training mechanical extrema; not an asymptotic stability proof.

speedup_note: About 20,089x ratio to saved teacher solve times; teacher timings were under concurrent generation, neural benchmarking was sequential.
external_validation_note: Proceed only after review, to test generalization of this experimental policy. Accuracy equivalence to MPC and physical/high-fidelity validation remain unestablished.
